answer.explanation: The $3,600 confocal microscope service contract (rq-104) was held for the grant manager. It failed "Grant is active and not frozen": R01GM061721 was canceled 2026-03-10, a court restored it on 2026-04-20, but no payment has arrived since, so spending stays frozen. It also failed "Shared cost split across the grants it serves": it serves R01GM061721 and R21AI182745 but is charged to R01GM061721 only (NSF OIG audit summary: shared costs charged 100% to one award). Next, the cost must be split between the two grants by use; send the split and it will be checked again.
